comparisons.author_judgement: 富 DME 正极相促进转化
comparisons.quote: The CPME/DME electrolyte demonstrates superior rate capability in Li-S batteries compared to DOL/DME electrolyte (Figures 3a and S7), delivering discharge capacities of 1141.66, 901.93, 829.13, 791.46, 767.06, and 750.13 mA h g−1 at 0.1C, 0.2C, 0.4C, 0.6C, 0.8C, and 1C

comparisons.author_judgement: CPME 相阻挡多硫化物向负极扩散
comparisons.quote: the CPME/DME system achieves 86.9% capacity retention after 200 cycles at 0.2C with 99.9% Coulombic efficiency. In contrast, conventional DOL/DME system shows only 66.8% retention and 98.1% Coulombic efficiency under identical conditions

comparisons.author_judgement: CPME 相物理阻挡多硫化物向负极扩散
comparisons.reason_quote: This confirms that the CPME phase effectively blocks LiPSs diffusion to the anode via physical barrier effects
